title.zh: 复现 GPT-2 的 MLP 并实现 SwiGLU
title.en: Reproduce GPT-2's MLP and implement SwiGLU

prompt.zh: 用权重复现 GPT-2 的 MLP 层。再实现 SwiGLU，并算出让它与标准 FFN 参数量相同的隐藏宽度。
prompt.en: Reproduce the MLP layer of GPT-2 from its weights. Then implement SwiGLU and compute the hidden width at which it has the same number of parameters as the standard FFN.

hints.zh: GPT-2 的 GELU 用的是 tanh 近似，需要写成 `F.gelu(z, approximate="tanh")`，否则数值会有微小差别。
hints.en: GPT-2 uses the tanh approximation of GELU, written `F.gelu(z, approximate="tanh")`. Without it the numbers differ slightly.
From $3dh = 8d^2$ follows $h = 8d/3$. Use integer division, `8 * d // 3`.
